quality_policy: source fill/missing and source valid range if present; otherwise contract screen

quality_policy: source fill/missing and source valid range if present; otherwise contract screen

quality_policy: source fill/missing and source valid range if present; otherwise contract screen

quality_policy: source fill/missing and source valid range if present; otherwise contract screen

name: Final merged satellite-gauge monthly mean precipitation rate
quality_policy: source fill/missing and source valid range if present; does not mask precipitation using quality index

name: Precipitation accumulation derived from monthly mean rate
quality_policy: monthly mean rate multiplied by exact proleptic Gregorian calendar hours; separate from NASA-provided rate

name: IMERG random error estimate
quality_policy: retain as source uncertainty context; not a confidence interval for the regional mean

name: IMERG precipitation quality index
screen_type: nonnegative sanity screen only; no quality threshold imposed
quality_policy: reported as an index; never interpreted as a probability or used to mask precipitation
